Package scope & handover

The package covers one property or apartment type using three supplied views. It includes the final image exports, one standalone page based on the layouts shown, a PDF of up to four pages and two campaign layouts, in one language. Hosting is agreed before production; domain and third-party hosting charges are separate.

Provide approved property information, brand assets and images you have permission to use. One consolidated correction round within the agreed brief is included. New 3D modelling, new camera views, interactive tours and additional deliverables require a separate quote.
